steps.action: C54 step 7: the exact row-menu items a Contributor is offered, and the refusals behind them
steps.actual: Observed in the browser: on a one-Version Document the Contributor's row menu held exactly ["Add version"], and once the chain had a predecessor it held exactly ["Compare with previous", "Add version"]. Compare is a read, so it is offered; no kind editor and no Show archived control appeared. Observed through this Contributor's own API session: archive, restore and delete each answered 403, and the Document stayed live with both Versions

steps.action: C54 step 29: permanent deletion removes the stored files, checked in the lab volume itself
steps.actual: Observed in the owned lab's storage volume by a read-only listing: before the erasure 3 stored files existed under this Document's key, one for each of its three Versions. Observed in the browser: the typed confirmation removed the row. Observed in the volume again: no file remains under that key. Observed through the API: all three Version downloads answer 404 and the Contract's activity feed still names the erased Document
